tags: 5 Knuckle Full Mortise Swing Clear Hinges

text.description_html:
Stanley F2484, 5 Knuckle Full Mortise Swing Clear Hinge

The 4 inch Swing Clear Hinge is used to create a maximum amount of clear opening in a doorway. This is often used to satifisy ADA requirements. The 5 Knuckle Full Mortise Swing Clear Hinge has a template hole pattern.

Features and Specifications of the Standard Weight Plain Bearing Swing Clear Full Mortise Hinge:

  • Material: Steel
  • Length of Joint: 4"
  • Thickness: .130"
  • Screws: 8-12 X 1-1/4 Flat Head Wood Screws.
  • Equipped with easily seated non-rising pins.
  • Reversible flush tips and pins.
  • Ideal for remodeling or new construction.
  • Available for full mortise application on square edge doors only.
  • Designed to replace existing 3-1/2" (89mm) or 4" (102mm) hinges or Swing Clear openings (some modification of preparation may be required for residential use).
  • Designed to swing doors completely clear of the opening when door is opened 95°

Sold as a Pair (2 Hinges)
